content: 1. Calcium carbonate reduces the levels of gabapentin enacarbil by inhibiting gastrointestinal (GI) absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. To minimize this effect, separate the administration of these drugs by at least 2 hours. Use caution and monitor the patient closely. 2.
